evidence: Modifies IPC socket listening configuration in src/ipc/listen.cpp and tests in src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an unintuitive `-ipcbind` parsing error where specifying options on default Unix sockets required an obscure colon separator (`unix:,max-connections=...`). As noted in issue #36657, `unix,max-connections=...` previously failed to parse.
